summary: Sister of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle and wife of Thomas Christopher Halloran; John's great-grand-aunt.
bio: Mary Elizabeth Pringle was born in Pennsylvania in March 1898, a daughter of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan. She was in her parents' household at Plymouth/Larksville in 1910 and was living in Wilkes-Barre in 1920. On 7 June 1922, in Luzerne County, she married Thomas Christopher Halloran (1898–1967).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (1910 Plymouth census list of Catherine Heffernan Pringle's children)

researchNotes:
Child of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan, born about 1898, listed in the 1910 census (Plymouth/Larksville) household. No further research done.

FamilySearch gives Mary Elizabeth Pringle a birth date of March 1898 (from the 1900 census), places her in Wilkes-Barre's 15th ward in 1920, and records her marriage in Luzerne Co. on 7 Jun 1922 to Thomas Christopher Halloran (1898-1967) ([R4-S1]). No death date has been found.
